name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.argsOf_length_le
typeText:
∀ {n : Nat} {g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance},
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Sized n g →
    ∀ (j : Nat), LE.le.{0} (List.length.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.argsOf g j)) n

source.code:
theorem argsOf_length_le {n : ℕ} {g : GInstance} (hn : Sized n g) (j : ℕ) : (g.argsOf j).length ≤ n := by
  unfold GInstance.argsOf
  by_cases hj : j < g.base.nodes.length
  · rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hj]
    have hmem := List.getElem_mem hj
    generalize g.base.nodes[j] = nd at hmem
    cases nd with
    | src i => simp
    | app f args => exact hn.args _ hmem f args rfl
  · rw [List.getD_eq_default _ _ (by omega)]; simp
